title: GenerateRecapResponse
description: Response shape returned by the supabase.functions.invoke('generate-recap') call after feature 021. The `image` field is forward-additive: clients written before feature 021 continue to work because they ignore unknown properties.

id.description: Recap row id; client uses this to subscribe to image-status updates via Realtime.

memory_jogger.description: EXISTING — recent events recap. Source-of-truth for the image prompt.

progress_snapshot.description: EXISTING — percentage at time of recap.

image.description: NEW (021) — image metadata. The actual image bytes are NOT in the response; the client retrieves them via a signed URL minted from `path`.

status.description: Initial state; will be 'pending' for newly generated recaps. Clients subscribe to the recap row via Realtime to observe transitions.

path.description: Bucket-relative path inside `recap-images`. Null until status='succeeded'.

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp when status flipped to 'succeeded'. Null otherwise.
